LeafDiagnosis.heroTitle: See what your leaves are trying to tell you.
LeafDiagnosis.heroDescription: Upload a clear leaf image and let our AI identify potential plant diseases in seconds.
LeafDiagnosis.uploadTitle: Upload a clear image of a plant leaf
LeafDiagnosis.dropImage: Drop your image here, or browse
LeafDiagnosis.uploadHint: Use a well-lit, close-up image with the leaf in focus. Maximum size: 10 MB.
LeafDiagnosis.analyzingStatus: AI is examining the image for disease patterns.
LeafDiagnosis.emptyDescription: Upload a leaf image to see the predicted condition, confidence score, and alternative matches.
LeafDiagnosis.emptyTip: For the best result, avoid heavy shadows and keep the leaf centered.
LeafDiagnosis.loadingDescription: This usually takes only a few seconds.
LeafDiagnosis.footer: LeafLens AI · Built with Next.js, FastAPI, and TensorFlow

errors.invalidType: Please choose a JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image.
errors.fileTooLarge: That image is larger than 10 MB. Please choose a smaller image.
errors.noFile: Choose a leaf image before starting an analysis.
errors.connection: Unable to connect to the AI server. Please make sure the backend is running and try again.
errors.invalidImage: This image could not be analyzed. Please choose a clear leaf image and try again.
errors.server: The AI server could not analyze this image. Please try again shortly.
errors.unexpected: The AI server returned an unexpected response. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

PredictionResult.healthySummary: Keep up these practices to help it stay healthy.
PredictionResult.conditionSummary: Use these signs and practices to guide your next steps.
PredictionResult.unknownDescription: The model identified {disease}, but a matching care guide has not been added to the disease dataset.
